note: mapping_basis=data_labels: ES3490 VARIABLE LABELS (identical in 3490.sav, read with haven) ESCIDEOL 'Escala de autoubicación ideológica (1-10)', PROBVOTO 'Escala de probabilidad de voto (0-10) en elecciones generales'; codigo3490.pdf lists C1 ESCIDEOL and C2 PROBVOTO with the same labels. VALUE LABELS: ESCIDEOL 1 '1 Izquierda' 10 '10 Derecha' 98 'N.S.' 99 'N.C.' (2..9 labelled only with their digit); PROBVOTO 0 '0 Con toda seguridad no iría a votar' 10 '10 Con toda seguridad, iría a votar' 97 'No procede' 98 'N.S.' 99 'N.C.' (1..9 digit only). DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: the .do imports 3490_num.csv with case(lower) and in Bookmark 8 loops gen item = the literal names escideol probvoto, so the item code IS the CIS column name lowercased; nothing positional, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. The two items are also self-describing and differ in range (1-10 vs 0-10). CHECKED ANYWAY, decisively: re-running the .do logic on 3490_num.csv (N=2562; id = row number; escideol 98/99 to missing, .do line 351; probvoto 97/98/99 to missing, .do line 352; no other recode) reproduces the live table exactly -- 4895 rows, id-item-resp row sets identical (0/0 set differences, 0 duplicates) against the local irw cache parquet written by table_context.R (no additional export). Per-item n escideol 2437 / probvoto 2458 = irw_table_sets(per_item=TRUE). item x resp cells identical rebuild vs live at every level, e.g. escideol 1..10 = 200/190/403/273/561/223/236/177/56/118; probvoto 0..10 = 174/26/31/22/20/60/37/45/115/125/1803. Dropped codes: escideol 98 N.S. 22, 99 N.C. 103; probvoto 97 N.P. 98, 98 N.S. 4, 99 N.C. 2 (of 2562). probvoto 97 coincides exactly with NACIONALIDAD=3 (98/98 both ways), matching the questionnaire filter 'Si NACIONALIDAD=3 ir a C7' -- foreign nationals were not asked C.2; ESCIDEOL carries no filter. Coherence: mean escideol 4.8, mean probvoto 8.6 with 73% (1803/2458) at 10 (typical for a stated-turnout item); r(escideol,probvoto)=0.02 over 2343 pairwise-complete rows (independent constructs, as expected). text_source=study_materials: item_text transcribed verbatim from cues3490.pdf (pdftotext -layout and -raw agree), line breaks joined with a space, curly quotes kept as printed; 'En una escala de 1 al 10' is printed thus (not 'del 1 al 10') and kept. C.1 and C.2 are two separate questions, each with its own full question and response set, so instructions is blank (the batch_357 difficulty convention) and each question is its item_text; single trivial section_id. The routing line 'Filtros: Si NACIONALIDAD=3 ir a C7' is an interviewer/CATI direction and not shipped; no ENTREVISTADOR/A directions and no CATI fill tokens in C.1 or C.2. OPTION TEXT: shipped for the end points only, as printed in the questionnaire's response list: escideol 1 'Izda.' and 10 'Dcha.'; probvoto 0 'No iría a votar seguro' and 10 'Iría a votar seguro' (leading digit stripped, as in the batch_354/356 CIS 0/1-10 tables). DEVIATION NOTE: the .sav/ES3490 value labels word the end points differently ('Izquierda'/'Derecha'; 'Con toda seguridad no iría a votar'/'Con toda seguridad, iría a votar' -- the latter being the wording read in the question itself); the questionnaire's printed option list was preferred as the administered form. Interior points (escideol 2..9, probvoto 1..9) carry no verbal label in either source and are left blank, not padded. RESP: CIS codes stored unchanged (no recode or reversal in Bookmark 8); escideol 1 = furthest left ... 10 = furthest right; probvoto 0 = definitely would not vote ... 10 = definitely would vote. escideol uses all ten of 1..10 (no 0 row, as the scale has no 0); probvoto uses all eleven of 0..10; every used level has an option row for its item. No option rows for 97/98/99. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3490 in Spanish only; the _translated columns were written by IRW ('Izda.'/'Dcha.' rendered 'Left'/'Right'). STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Left-right ideological self-placement and self-reported likelihood of voting' matches ESCIDEOL (C.1) + PROBVOTO (C.2) exactly; no instrument mismatch.
